behaviors.description: Initialize app, runtime and extension builds and reject an unknown type.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent installed SDK and extension fixtures.
behaviors.expected: Types select the correct metadata group, runtime SDK copy and extension parent; unknown types create no metadata.

behaviors.description: Preserve explicit extension mount-point tags in initialized metadata.
behaviors.expected: Two tag values remain distinguishable from untagged initialization while the parent ref is preserved.

behaviors.description: Populate the build var directory from a selected runtime.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent runtime with a known payload marker.
behaviors.expected: The selected marker appears in var only; ordinary initialization lacks it.

behaviors.description: Copy an installed extension into a writable SDK only when requested.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent SDK and extension with distinct payload markers.
behaviors.expected: Explicit extension selection adds its exact marker at the declared directory and retains the SDK marker; the control omits it.

behaviors.description: Copy a base app extension only when explicitly requested.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent installed base app and related extension with distinct markers.
behaviors.expected: Explicit selection copies extension bytes at the declared mount directory while retaining base bytes; the control omits the extension.

mappings.rationale: Public build layout and metadata distinguish every supported type and rejection.

surface_assertions.rationale: App, runtime and extension produce distinct expected layouts and metadata.

mappings.rationale: The public ExtensionOf tag persists the selected mount-point identity.

surface_assertions.rationale: Exact first/second tag values differ from an untagged control.

mappings.rationale: Independent marker bytes distinguish a populated var directory from the ordinary empty one.

surface_assertions.rationale: The selected runtime payload populates var without replacing files.

mappings.rationale: Installed presence alone is insufficient; the option must copy the extension payload.

surface_assertions.rationale: Selected extension bytes appear at their SDK mount point only in the flagged build.

mappings.rationale: The base copy and extension copy have independent payload oracles.

surface_assertions.rationale: Selected base extension bytes appear at their declared mount point only in the flagged build.
